sections.heading: Decision chain
paragraphs: SOC confirms a personal-data event and opens the legal decision ticket. The privacy office drafts a Board submission and consumer message from the affected-customer list.
The affected-customer list is generated from the customer data inventory. Release to the Board and to users follows the decision owner entered in the incident ticket.

sections.heading: September rehearsal
paragraphs: A 2026-09-14 drill produced a complete SOC timeline and public statement draft. The Board submission was left in draft because the customer inventory could not resolve pre-migration IDs.
